chunks: My father and the group of my scholars and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya and Ahmad ibn Idris, from al-Amraki, from Yahya (who was in the service of Abi Ja'far (AS)), from some of our companions, from Abi Abdillah (AS)
He said: Verily, on the outskirts of Kufah there is a grave; no distressed person visits it except that Allah relieves his distress, referring to the grave of al-Husayn (AS).

key_terms.ظَهْرُ الْكُوفَةِ: The outskirts or outskirts area of Kufah

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn (AS) in Kufah?
ai.summary: This hadith from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat* highlights the spiritual efficacy of visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn (AS) in Kufah, emphasizing its role as a divine conduit for removing *kurbah* (distress). It reflects the Shia tradition of *ziyarat* not merely as a ritual, but as a means of accessing intercessory grace and emotional solace through the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 6. My father, Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan and all of my scholars narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, and from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from ‘Amraki, from Yaḥyā – who was the servant of Abī Ja’far (Imam Jawād (a.s.)), from some of our companions, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
Verily there is a grave on the outskirts of Kūfah – referring to the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) – to which no anguished person goes without Allāh relieving him of his anguish.
